description: Data science uses information to answer questions. Learn to organise, clean and compare small fictional datasets, then explain what the numbers can and cannot tell us. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain read a tiny csv table
learningObjectives: Practise mean and median show different centres

seo.title: Data Science Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Data Science with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
